text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "An indicative (in German) includes all products excluded from the «Cassis de Dijon principle».", "gist": "The German version of the text lists products excluded from the Cassis de Dijon principle."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Swiss manufacturers, who produce exclusively for the Swiss market, can also place products manufactured according to the regulations of EU or EU/EEA member state on the Swiss market (measures aimed at avoiding discrimination of domestic manufacturers).", "gist": "Swiss manufacturers can sell EU/EEA-compliant products in Switzerland to prevent discrimination."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "foodstuffs", "gist": "Category of goods being discussed"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "The application of the «Cassis de Dijon principle» for foodstuffs is subject to specific provisions (authorisation process).", "gist": "Foodstuffs must go through an authorization process to apply the Cassis de Dijon principle."}]}
